probe.ask: Reply with only the exact text of my previous message, nothing else.

notes: Measured 2026-11-15 on the Antigravity CLI (agy). Store: one SQLite file per conversation at ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/conversations/<conversation uuid>.db, WAL mode (read through a copy opened with ?immutable=1). Tables: trajectory_meta(trajectory_id, cascade_id=conversation id, trajectory_type, source), steps(idx, step_type, status, ..., metadata, step_payload, step_format), executor_metadata(idx, data), trajectory_metadata_blob(id, data), gen_metadata, parent_references, battle_mode_infos. step_payload is protobuf: field 1 step type (14 user, 15 model reply, 132 tool call), 4 status, 5 step metadata (same bytes as the metadata column: 1 timestamp, 20/2 step index, 20/3 generation index, 35 per-step hex id, 6/7 start/end time), 19 user input (2 text, 3/1 text item, 12 workspace config), 20 model reply (1 and 8 text, 3 reasoning, 14 reasoning signature, 6 bot id, 7 tool call). The write hook clones the newest local conversation as a template, swaps every id and workspace path, replaces only text fields and drops reasoning plus signature. gen_metadata is not written. Resume: agy --conversation <id> --print <text>.
